ideas.name: Dealer Gamma Intraday Reversal
ideas.claim: Positive dealer inventory gamma is associated with stronger intraday price reversal; negative gamma is associated with stronger intraday momentum.
ideas.quote: We also show evidence suggesting that positive (negative) Market Makers’ inventory gamma strengthens intraday price reversal (momentum).
ideas.mechanism: VOL: market makers' delta hedging of 0DTE option inventory

rules.timeframe: Intraday; interval not stated in the abstract
rules.filters: Sign of market makers' inventory gamma

ideas.claimed_result: Positive inventory gamma strengthens intraday reversal, while negative inventory gamma strengthens intraday momentum; the abstract does not quantify either effect.
